---
title: "Downloads"
---

The tool installs from its repository with uv, which also installs the right version of Python:

```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox@v0.2.0
```

Each tagged release also carries a wheel, for machines that install from a file:

| Version | Date | Wheel | Notes |
|:--|:--|:--|:----|
| 0.2.0 | 2026-11-16 | `esa_toolbox-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` | Revision of the pollination method, with the dependency ratios of Siopa et al. (2024) and the bumblebee model projected to each reporting year |

: Releases. {#tbl-releases}

```bash
uv tool install ./esa_toolbox-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

The results themselves, the workbooks, maps and reports, are not downloads of the tool. Each run writes them to its own outputs
folder, and the report of a run names the tool version that made it. However, the results of a complete run of the latest version
can be downloaded below.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Results of the latest version

The shared folder holds the outputs folder of each service, with its workbook, its 100 m maps and its report, which names the
tool version and the inputs of the run. The folder opens in a new tab, and each file in it can be downloaded on its own, which
helps with the maps, since they are large.

[<i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download the results](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/lte2qpmg4vty43l430nxv/AFIbiyPqZzoKQhmzn_YNSuE?rlkey=hkf3cqpbxyhcqhuwzozat174z&st=sfwi7168&dl=0){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::
